snippet.title: Redmercy
snippet.description:
High lvl LoL gameplay/commentary.
Hey guys, welcome to my channel :) I will be posting LoL clipsthat consist of funny moments, guides, tutorial and everything you would want!

Send me vids or for any inquiries such as sponsorships contact me at: redmercy1991@gmail.com

Computer Specs 
Internal Lighting - Ironside RGB Lighting
Intel Processor Haswell - Intel Core i7-6900k 3.7GHz (Octa Core)
CPU Cooling - Level 1 - Iron Tundra Custom Liquid Cooling [240mm Radiator]
Intel Motherboard 2011 - [4 Way X-fire & SLI] Gigabyte GA-X99-SLI
Memory - 64GB (8x8GB) DDR4 2133MHz
Primary Hard Drive - 500GB Ironside Titanium Series SSD
Secondary Hard Drive - 2TB 7200 RPM
Optical Drive - DVD Writer
Graphics Card - Nvidia Geforce GTX Titan X (Pascal) 12GB (Min. 600 Watt)
Graphics Card Cooling - Stock GPU Cooler
Power Supply - Standard 800 Watt
Operating System - Windows 10 64 Bit


My Stream: http://www.twitch.tv/redmercylol
